author_observations: Matched front, side, back and three-quarter views inspected from the exact rigged GLB.
Muted gray-brown shell, padded belly/limbs, long blunt muzzle and round ears preserve the rat silhouette.
Plain fitted burgundy vest, seam repairs and tired eyelids replace the paused glossy slim treatment.
All five exact clips inspected in Chromium; stronger attack warning is readable at about 200 px body height.
Attack side contact, held defeat side, back tail attachment and dice hand checked visually; no visible detached part or floor/suit penetration.
lead_feedback_integrated: Shirt and vest now follow the curved torso.
Padded pelvis, reduced shoulder motors and matte joints.
Raised free fist and restrained upper-body/head lean at attack; defeat unchanged.
lead_decision: Accepted construction and revised attack motion direction before final packaging.
deviations: Original synthetic construction resolves the reference as a 14,698-triangle mobile candidate, without photoreal fur strands.
Procedural atlas uses 256 colors at 1024 px to preserve the selected matte palette within the 2 MiB budget.
limitations: Chromium software WebGL, not a physical iPad/iPhone Safari test.
No gameplay integration or frame-time performance acceptance claimed.
